dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Has that made arranging calls difficult? We can keep future portfolio reviews to an agreed agenda and arrange them directly with you by email, rather than trying to reach you during the working day.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Email would be best. I'm delegating more of the daily operations, but my diary is still changeable. Send an agenda beforehand so I can prepare and make proper time for the conversation.
